SELECT d.department_id AS departmentId, #{tenantCode} AS tenantCode, d.department_nm AS name, d.parent_department_id AS parentId, pd.department_nm AS parentName, COALESCE(d.sort_order, 0) AS sortOrder, CASE WHEN d.use_at = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS active, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_department cd WHERE cd.parent_department_id = d.department_id ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS hasChildren FROM tb_department d LEFT JOIN tb_department pd ON pd.department_id = d.parent_department_id WHERE 1 = 1
AND d.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
AND ( LOWER(d.department_nm) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{name}) || '%' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_department cd WHERE cd.parent_department_id = d.department_id AND LOWER(cd.department_nm) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{name}) || '%' ) )
AND d.use_at = 'Y'
AND d.use_at = 'N'
ORDER BY d.parent_department_id NULLS FIRST, COALESCE(d.sort_order, 0), d.department_id
